actions.help: Returns the field metadata Zoho holds for a module: API names, data types, whether a field is required or read-only, and the allowed values of a picklist. Use it to discover what can be written to a record before building the request.

input.name: type
input.label: Fields to return
input.hint: Leave blank for the fields in use. All adds unused fields, Unused returns only those.

input.name: include
input.label: Include
input.hint: Adds the profile permissions that may update each field.

actions.name: list_related_records
actions.title: List related objects
actions.description: List related objects in Zoho CRM
actions.help: Lists the records linked to a parent record through one of its related lists, such as the contacts under an account. Zoho requires an explicit field list, so pick the fields to return; the output is built from them.
